files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] kind service and entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm or AI dependencies.

Define plain obj records with string/float/list defaults: RepoSelection(repo_path, repo_name, branch="main", is_valid=False), ChatMessage(role="user", content, created_at), DecisionItem(title, detail, confidence:float=0.0, source), BlockerItem(title, detail, severity="medium", owner_hint), FileMatch(path, score:float=0.0, rationale, kind="file"), OwnershipGuess(area, owner, confidence:float=0.0, rationale) and MeetingSummary(summary, action_items:list[str], decisions:list[DecisionItem], blockers:list[BlockerItem], people, systems, deadlines, uncertainty:list[str]). No imports.

signatures.DecisionItem: obj DecisionItem { has title: str = ""; has detail: str = ""; has confidence: float = 0.0; has source: str = ""; }
signatures.BlockerItem: obj BlockerItem { has title: str = ""; has detail: str = ""; has severity: str = "medium"; has owner_hint: str = ""; }

files.purpose: Define obj records WorkflowMode(key="feature_plan", label, description), WorkflowTraceStep(stage, agent, status, started_at, finished_at, detail, execution_mode="deterministic", model_name, fallback_reason), WorkflowRequest(repo_path, meeting_text, prompt, mode="feature_plan", user_api_key, user_model), WorkflowRunState(run_id, mode, kind="full_run", status="idle", summary, execution_mode="fallback", model_name, fallback_reason), PlanningInsight(title, detail, severity="medium", category="context") and ExecutionPlanningContext(resolved_areas, impacts, test_gaps, blocker_titles:list[str], resolved_mappings, blocker_insights, impact_insights, test_gap_insights:list[PlanningInsight]). No imports.

signatures.WorkflowRequest: obj WorkflowRequest { has repo_path: str = ""; has meeting_text: str = ""; has prompt: str = ""; has mode: str = "feature_plan"; has user_api_key: str = ""; has user_model: str = ""; }

files.purpose: Import FileMatch, MeetingSummary, DecisionItem, BlockerItem, OwnershipGuess from app.models.core and WorkflowTraceStep, WorkflowRunState, ExecutionPlanningContext, PlanningInsight from app.models.workflow. Define obj records RepoSummary, TaskItem, ActionPlan(headline, first_task, next_task, phases), GeneratedTicket(title, summary, priority="medium", acceptance_criteria, likely_files, blockers, dependencies), HandoffNoteData, StandupUpdateData, ReviewScopeData, GraphNodeView, GraphEdgeView, ProjectContextGraph, DocsSyncResult(files:list[FileMatch], decisions:list[DecisionItem]), QueryArtifactAnswer, WorkflowResultBundle (every result section with default instances: repo_summary, meeting_summary, relevant_files, ownership, decisions:list[DecisionItem], blockers:list[BlockerItem], planning, action_plan:ActionPlan, tasks, tickets:list[GeneratedTicket], handoff, standup, review, trace, context_graph, run_state) and RepoGhostViewState (UI state record holding a bundle, graph views, planning insights and optional callbacks). Also define helpers docs_sync_files and docs_sync_decisions.

signatures.ActionPlan: obj ActionPlan { has headline: str = ""; has first_task: str = ""; has next_task: str = ""; has phases: list[str] = []; }
signatures.GeneratedTicket: obj GeneratedTicket { has title: str = ""; has summary: str = ""; has priority: str = "medium"; has acceptance_criteria: list[str] = []; has likely_files: list[str] = []; has blockers: list[str] = []; has dependencies: list[str] = []; }
signatures.WorkflowResultBundle: obj WorkflowResultBundle { has repo_summary: RepoSummary = RepoSummary(); has meeting_summary: MeetingSummary = MeetingSummary(); has relevant_files: list[FileMatch] = []; has ownership: list[OwnershipGuess] = []; has decisions: list[DecisionItem] = []; has blockers: list[BlockerItem] = []; has planning: ExecutionPlanningContext = ExecutionPlanningContext(); has action_plan: ActionPlan = ActionPlan(); has tasks: list[TaskItem] = []; has tickets: list[GeneratedTicket] = []; has handoff: HandoffNoteData = HandoffNoteData(); has standup: StandupUpdateData = StandupUpdateData(); has review: ReviewScopeData = ReviewScopeData(); has trace: list[WorkflowTraceStep] = []; has context_graph: ProjectContextGraph = ProjectContextGraph(); has run_state: WorkflowRunState = WorkflowRunState(); }

files.purpose: Import datetime, WorkflowRequest from app.models.workflow and WorkflowResultBundle from app.models.outputs. Keep glob SESSION_RUNS: list[dict] and glob PROJECT_MEMORY: dict[str, dict]. remember_session appends and returns {repo_path, mode, prompt, saved_at (str of datetime.now()), headline from bundle.action_plan.headline}. recent_session_runs returns SESSION_RUNS. update_project_memory stores under key repo_path or "default" a dict of decision titles, blocker titles, ticket titles and updated_at, and returns it. get_project_memory returns the stored dict or {decisions:[], blockers:[], tickets:[], updated_at:""}.

signatures.remember_session: def:pub remember_session(request: WorkflowRequest, bundle: WorkflowResultBundle) -> dict
signatures.update_project_memory: def:pub update_project_memory(repo_path: str, bundle: WorkflowResultBundle) -> dict

files.purpose: Import remember_session, recent_session_runs, update_project_memory and get_project_memory from app.services.memory_store so the service registers them at startup; no browser client or JSX.

verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and Jac behavior tests that build WorkflowRequest and WorkflowResultBundle objects from the model modules and pass them through the memory_store functions, using unique repository paths because module state persists across tests.

assumption: Backend slice of Async-Avengers/repoGhost (JacHacks 2026). The four app modules are taken verbatim from the checked source; app/models/outputs.jac is a sweep-repaired file. The source main.jac imports UI, LLM and git-backed services, so a thin main.jac that imports only the memory operations replaces it.
